articles.title: Political Twist: Sharad Pawar Rejects NCP Merger Buzz, Says No Question of Reuniting Factions
articles.description: Maharashtra politics has witnessed a fresh twist after veteran leader Sharad Pawar dismissed speculation about a possible reunion between the two factions of the Nationalist Congress Party (NCP). Addressing the ongoing discussions around a possible merger of the Sharad Pawar-led NCP faction and Ajit Pawar’s group, Sharad Pawar made it clear that there is no question of both sides coming together at this stage. For the past several weeks, political circles in Maharashtra have been filled with speculation that the two NCP factions could reunite. Reports had suggested that backchannel talks were underway and that a possible merger could be linked to future political developments. However, Sharad Pawar’s latest statement has put a pause on these discussions. The NCP split after Ajit Pawar and several MLAs joined the NDA alliance, creating two separate factions within the party. Since then, Maharashtra politics has continued to witness shifting equations, with leaders from different sides keeping the possibility of future alliances open. Sharad Pawar’s statement comes amid growing political discussions after meetings involving leaders from different camps. While he has rejected the merger rumours, political observers believe that Maharashtra’s political landscape can change rapidly and that future strategies may depend on evolving circumstances.
